Interface HttpExchangeAdapter

All Known Subinterfaces:
ReactorHttpExchangeAdapter
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractReactorHttpExchangeAdapter, HttpExchangeAdapterDecorator, NotFoundRestClientAdapterDecorator, NotFoundWebClientAdapterDecorator, ReactorHttpExchangeAdapterDecorator, RestClientAdapter, RestTemplateAdapter, WebClientAdapter
public interface HttpExchangeAdapter
Contract to abstract an HTTP client from HttpServiceProxyFactory and make it pluggable.

对于响应式客户端，请参见ReactorHttpExchangeAdapter。

Since:
6.1
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev
